item.author: J. K. Rowling
item.description: La fuga de Sirius Black de Azkaban lleva a los dementores a vigilar Hogwarts. Durante su tercer curso, Harry descubre versiones contradictorias del pasado de sus padres y debe aprender a distinguir entre las apariencias, los recuerdos y la lealtad.

en.description: Sirius Black's escape from Azkaban brings Dementors to guard Hogwarts. In his third year, Harry discovers conflicting accounts of his parents' past and must learn to distinguish appearances and memories from genuine loyalty.
en.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
